# Questions

1. Does cluster 3 have higher AR signaling than clusters 1 and 2?
2. Do AR-mutated tumors have higher AR signaling than wild-type tumors, also after adjusting for cluster?

AR signaling score = mean z-score (across tumors) of a set of AR target genes, AR itself excluded.

```{r paths_and_parameters}
vst_file     <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/NMF/vst_transformed_data.csv"

# k = 3 consensus clustering (GCT, column 'membership.ordered'). Adjust if it is stored elsewhere.
cluster_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/NMF/GenePattern_NMFConsensus/vst_transformed_data.consensus.k.3.gct"

impact_file  <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/MSK_IMPACT/pILC_IMPACT_filtered.tsv"

# Optional: MSigDB .gmt file (e.g. h.all.v*.Hs.symbols.gmt) and the set name to use.
# If NA, the built-in AR target list below is used.
gmt_file     <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/GSEA/Dataset/h.all.v2025.1.Hs.symbols.gmt"
gmt_set_name <- "HALLMARK_ANDROGEN_RESPONSE"

out_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/Cross_modality_concordance/AR_Signaling"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

MIN_SET_GENES <- 10   # minimum number of AR target genes found in the VST matrix

# Built-in AR target genes (AR itself excluded)
builtin_ar_targets <- c(
  "KLK3", "KLK2", "TMPRSS2", "NKX3-1", "FKBP5", "STEAP2", "PMEPA1", "ZBTB16", "SGK1",
  "ABCC4", "ACSL3", "ALDH1A3", "NDRG1", "SLC45A3", "TPD52", "UAP1", "ELL2", "MAF",
  "CAMKK2", "SPDEF", "ZMIZ1", "TSC22D1", "PDLIM5", "INPP4B", "HPGD", "AKAP12"

cluster_cols <- c("1" = "#4C78A8", "2" = "#F58518", "3" = "#54A24B")
status_cols  <- c("Mutated" = "#D62728", "Wild-type" = "#9AA5B1", "No IMPACT" = "white")

stopifnot(file.exists(vst_file), file.exists(impact_file))
```

```{r helpers}
# One ID format for every file: TP09-09T, TP09.9_S34, TP09-9  ->  TP09-9
std_id <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  x <- sub("^X(?=TP)", "", x, perl = TRUE)   # R adds X to names that start with a letter-digit mix
  x <- sub("_S[0-9]+$", "", x)       # RNA-seq library suffix
  x <- gsub("\\.", "-", x)           # TP05.791 -> TP05-791
  x <- sub("^JC287-", "", x)
  x <- sub("(_T|-T)$", "", x)
  x <- sub("(?<=[0-9])T$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  sub("-0+(?=[0-9])", "-", x, perl = TRUE)   # TP09-09 -> TP09-9
}

save_plot <- function(file_base, width, height, draw_fn, res = 300) {
  pdf(paste0(file_base, ".pdf"), width = width, height = height)
  draw_fn(); dev.off()
  png(paste0(file_base, ".png"), width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = res)
  draw_fn(); dev.off()
  cat("Saved:", paste0(file_base, c(".pdf", ".png")), sep = "\n  "); cat("\n")
}
```

```{r read_expression}
# ============================================================
# VST matrix: genes x tumors (or tumors x genes; detected automatically)
# ============================================================
x <- fread(vst_file)
cat("VST file:", nrow(x), "rows x", ncol(x), "columns\n")
cat("First columns:", paste(head(names(x), 6), collapse = " | "), "\n")

sample_like <- function(v) mean(grepl("^X?TP[0-9]+[.-]", toupper(as.character(v)))) > 0.5

if (sample_like(names(x)[-1])) {            # genes in rows
  genes <- as.character(x[[1]])
  mat <- as.matrix(x[, -1])
  rownames(mat) <- genes
} else if (sample_like(x[[1]])) {           # tumors in rows
  smp <- as.character(x[[1]])
  mat <- t(as.matrix(x[, -1]))
  colnames(mat) <- smp
} else {
  stop("Could not tell which axis holds the tumors. Please paste head(names(x)) and head(x[[1]]).")
}
storage.mode(mat) <- "numeric"

# Gene identifiers -> symbols
ids <- sub("\\..*$", "", rownames(mat))
if (mean(grepl("^ENSG", ids)) > 0.5) {
  if (!requireNamespace("org.Hs.eg.db", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Genes are Ensembl IDs but org.Hs.eg.db is not installed. ",
         "Install it (BiocManager::install('org.Hs.eg.db')) or provide a symbol-annotated matrix.")
  }
  sym <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db, keys = ids, column = "SYMBOL",
                               keytype = "ENSEMBL", multiVals = "first")
  rownames(mat) <- ifelse(is.na(sym), ids, sym)
} else {
  rownames(mat) <- toupper(rownames(mat))
}

# Several rows per symbol: average
d <- as.data.table(mat, keep.rownames = "Gene")
d <- d[, lapply(.SD, mean, na.rm = TRUE), by = Gene]
mat <- as.matrix(d[, -1]); rownames(mat) <- d$Gene

colnames(mat) <- std_id(colnames(mat))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(colnames(mat)))
cat("Tumors in VST matrix:", ncol(mat), "| genes:", nrow(mat), "\n")
cat("AR present:", "AR" %in% rownames(mat), "\n")
```

```{r clusters_and_mutation}
# ============================================================
# Cluster membership (k = 3)
# ============================================================
cl <- fread(cluster_file, skip = 2)
cl_col <- grep("membership", names(cl), value = TRUE)[1]
cl <- cl[, .(Tumor = std_id(Name), Cluster = as.character(get(cl_col)))]
cat("Cluster sizes:\n"); print(table(cl$Cluster))

tumors <- intersect(colnames(mat), cl$Tumor)
cat("Tumors with expression and cluster:", length(tumors), "of", ncol(mat), "\n")
if (length(setdiff(colnames(mat), cl$Tumor))) {
  cat("In VST but not in cluster file:", paste(setdiff(colnames(mat), cl$Tumor), collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# ============================================================
# AR mutation status from IMPACT
# ============================================================
imp <- fread(impact_file, sep = "\t", na.strings = c("", "NA"))
imp[, Tumor := std_id(TUMOR_SAMPLE)]
impact_tumors <- unique(imp$Tumor)

ar <- imp[SYMBOL == "AR", .(AR_variants = paste(HGVSp_Short, collapse = "; "),
                            AR_type = if (any(Variant_Classification == "Missense_Mutation")) "Missense"
                                      else "In-frame indel"), by = Tumor]

meta <- data.table(Tumor = tumors)
meta <- merge(meta, cl, by = "Tumor", all.x = TRUE)
meta <- merge(meta, ar, by = "Tumor", all.x = TRUE)
meta[, AR_status := fifelse(!is.na(AR_variants), "Mutated",
                    fifelse(Tumor %in% impact_tumors, "Wild-type", "No IMPACT"))]
meta[is.na(AR_type), AR_type := "None"]

cat("\nAR status of the tumors with expression:\n"); print(meta[, .N, by = AR_status])
cat("AR-mutated tumors without RNA-seq:",
    paste(setdiff(ar$Tumor, tumors), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r ar_score}
# ============================================================
# AR target gene set and score
# ============================================================
if (!is.na(gmt_file) && file.exists(gmt_file)) {
  lines <- strsplit(readLines(gmt_file), "\t")
  hit <- which(vapply(lines, `[`, "", 1) == gmt_set_name)
  if (length(hit) != 1) stop("Gene set '", gmt_set_name, "' not found exactly once in ", gmt_file)
  gs <- lines[[hit]]
  ar_targets <- toupper(gs[-(1:2)])
  set_label <- gmt_set_name
} else {
  ar_targets <- builtin_ar_targets
  set_label <- "built-in AR target list"
}
ar_targets <- setdiff(ar_targets, "AR")
present <- intersect(ar_targets, rownames(mat))
cat("AR target set:", set_label, "| genes in set:", length(ar_targets),
    "| found in VST:", length(present), "\n")
cat("Missing:", paste(setdiff(ar_targets, present), collapse = ", "), "\n")
if (length(present) < MIN_SET_GENES) stop("Fewer than ", MIN_SET_GENES, " AR target genes found.")

z <- t(scale(t(mat[present, tumors, drop = FALSE])))   # z-score each gene across tumors
meta[, AR_score := colMeans(z, na.rm = TRUE)[Tumor]]
meta[, AR_expr  := mat["AR", Tumor]]
meta[, Cluster  := factor(Cluster, levels = c("1", "2", "3"))]

fwrite(meta, file.path(out_dir, paste0("AR_score_per_tumor.tsv")), sep = "\t")
fwrite(data.table(Gene = present, Set = set_label),
       file.path(out_dir, paste0("AR_gene_set_used.tsv")), sep = "\t")
print(meta[order(Cluster, -AR_score), .(Tumor, Cluster, AR_status, AR_variants, round(AR_score, 2), round(AR_expr, 2))])
```

```{r waterfall}
# ============================================================
# Figure 0: waterfall plot of AR expression across all tumors with RNA-seq.
# Bars = AR expression (VST) relative to the cohort median, ranked high to low,
# coloured by cluster. Strips below: cluster, IMPACT AR status and AR variant type.
# The row under the strips shows the AR signaling score (mean z of AR target genes).
# ============================================================
ord <- meta[order(-AR_expr), Tumor]
mm  <- meta[match(ord, Tumor)]
med <- median(mm$AR_expr)
dev <- mm$AR_expr - med

wf_tab <- data.table(Rank = seq_len(nrow(mm)), Tumor = mm$Tumor, Cluster = mm$Cluster,
                     AR_expr_VST = round(mm$AR_expr, 3), Diff_from_median = round(dev, 3),
                     AR_score = round(mm$AR_score, 3), IMPACT_AR_status = mm$AR_status,
                     AR_variants = mm$AR_variants)
fwrite(wf_tab, file.path(out_dir, paste0("AR_waterfall_table.tsv")), sep = "\t")
print(wf_tab)

top_ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  `AR expr. vs median (VST)` = anno_barplot(
    dev, gp = gpar(fill = cluster_cols[as.character(mm$Cluster)], col = NA),
    baseline = 0, bar_width = 0.85, height = unit(4.5, "cm"),
    axis_param = list(gp = gpar(fontsize = 8))
  ),
  Cluster = as.character(mm$Cluster),
  `IMPACT AR status` = as.character(mm$AR_status),
  `IMPACT AR variant` = mm$AR_type,
  col = list(
    Cluster = cluster_cols,
    `IMPACT AR status` = status_cols,
    `IMPACT AR variant` = c("None" = "white", "In-frame indel" = "#2CA02C", "Missense" = "#1F77B4")
  ),
  border = TRUE, simple_anno_size = unit(0.4, "cm"), gap = unit(1.2, "mm"),
  annotation_name_side = "left", annotation_name_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8)
)

score_mat <- matrix(mm$AR_score, nrow = 1, dimnames = list("AR signaling score", mm$Tumor))
rng <- max(abs(score_mat), na.rm = TRUE)

ht_wf <- Heatmap(
  score_mat, name = "AR signaling\nscore (mean z)",
  col = colorRamp2(c(-rng, 0, rng), c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B")),
  cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_names = TRUE, row_names_side = "left", row_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 8),
  show_column_names = TRUE, column_names_gp = gpar(fontsize = 7),
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "white", lwd = 0.5),
  width = unit(max(90, 4.2 * ncol(score_mat)), "mm"), height = unit(0.5, "cm"),
  top_annotation = top_ha,
  column_title = paste0("AR expression across ", ncol(score_mat), " tumors with RNA-seq (ranked high to low)"),
  column_title_gp = gpar(fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold")
)

save_plot(file.path(out_dir, paste0("AR_waterfall")), width = 11, height = 6.5,
          draw_fn = function() draw(ht_wf, padding = unit(c(4, 4, 4, 8), "mm")))
```

```{r statistics}
# ============================================================
# Tests (exploratory; small groups, non-parametric)
# ============================================================
res <- list()
add <- function(...) res[[length(res) + 1]] <<- data.table(...)

for (v in c("AR_score", "AR_expr")) {
  lab <- if (v == "AR_score") "AR signaling score" else "AR expression (VST)"
  y <- meta[[v]]

  kw <- kruskal.test(y ~ meta$Cluster)
  add(Variable = lab, Test = "Kruskal-Wallis across clusters", Group = "1 vs 2 vs 3",
      n = length(y), Statistic = unname(kw$statistic), p = kw$p.value)

  pw <- pairwise.wilcox.test(y, meta$Cluster, p.adjust.method = "BH", exact = FALSE)
  for (a in rownames(pw$p.value)) for (b in colnames(pw$p.value)) {
    if (!is.na(pw$p.value[a, b])) {
      add(Variable = lab, Test = "Pairwise Wilcoxon (BH-adjusted)", Group = paste(b, "vs", a),
          n = sum(meta$Cluster %in% c(a, b)), Statistic = NA_real_, p = pw$p.value[a, b])
    }
  }

  w3 <- wilcox.test(y[meta$Cluster == "3"], y[meta$Cluster != "3"], exact = FALSE)
  add(Variable = lab, Test = "Wilcoxon", Group = "cluster 3 vs clusters 1+2",
      n = length(y), Statistic = unname(w3$statistic), p = w3$p.value)

  tested <- meta[AR_status %in% c("Mutated", "Wild-type")]
  wm <- wilcox.test(tested[[v]][tested$AR_status == "Mutated"],
                    tested[[v]][tested$AR_status == "Wild-type"], exact = FALSE)
  add(Variable = lab, Test = "Wilcoxon", Group = "AR-mutated vs wild-type",
      n = nrow(tested), Statistic = unname(wm$statistic), p = wm$p.value)

  fit <- lm(tested[[v]] ~ tested$Cluster + I(tested$AR_status == "Mutated"))
  cf <- summary(fit)$coefficients
  add(Variable = lab, Test = "Linear model: AR mutation, adjusted for cluster",
      Group = "AR-mutated vs wild-type", n = nrow(tested),
      Statistic = cf[nrow(cf), "Estimate"], p = cf[nrow(cf), "Pr(>|t|)"])
}
stats_dt <- rbindlist(res)
stats_dt[, p := signif(p, 3)]
fwrite(stats_dt, file.path(out_dir, paste0("AR_signaling_statistics.tsv")), sep = "\t")
print(stats_dt)

cat("\nMedian AR signaling score per cluster:\n")
print(meta[, .(n = .N, median_score = round(median(AR_score), 2), median_AR_expr = round(median(AR_expr), 2)), by = Cluster][order(Cluster)])
```

```{r boxplots}
# ============================================================
# Figure 1: AR score and AR expression by cluster, Nature-style statistics.
# Exact P values (no stars), brackets for the pairwise tests (Wilcoxon, BH-adjusted),
# overall Kruskal-Wallis P in each panel, n per cluster on the x axis.
# ============================================================
long <- melt(meta, id.vars = c("Tumor", "Cluster", "AR_status"),
             measure.vars = c("AR_score", "AR_expr"), variable.name = "Measure", value.name = "Value")
meas_levels <- c("AR signaling score (mean z)", "AR expression (VST)")
long[, Measure := factor(Measure, c("AR_score", "AR_expr"), meas_levels)]
long[, AR_status := factor(AR_status, c("Mutated", "Wild-type", "No IMPACT"))]

p_expr <- function(p) if (p < 0.001) "italic(P) < 0.001" else paste0("italic(P) == ", sprintf("%.3f", p))

var_map <- c("AR signaling score" = meas_levels[1], "AR expression (VST)" = meas_levels[2])

# pairwise brackets from the statistics table (BH-adjusted P)
pw <- stats_dt[Test == "Pairwise Wilcoxon (BH-adjusted)"]
pw[, `:=`(g1 = as.integer(sub(" vs .*", "", Group)), g2 = as.integer(sub(".* vs ", "", Group)),
          Measure = factor(var_map[Variable], meas_levels))]
pw[, level := fifelse(g2 - g1 == 1L, 1L, 2L)]

rng <- long[, .(lo = min(Value), hi = max(Value)), by = Measure][, span := hi - lo]
pw <- merge(pw, rng, by = "Measure")
pw[, y := hi + span * (0.05 + 0.11 * (level - 1))]
pw[, tick := span * 0.025]
pw[, label := vapply(p, p_expr, character(1))]

kw <- stats_dt[Test == "Kruskal-Wallis across clusters"]
kw[, Measure := factor(var_map[Variable], meas_levels)]
kw <- merge(kw, rng, by = "Measure")
kw[, `:=`(y = hi + span * 0.40, label = paste0("'Kruskal-Wallis'~", vapply(p, p_expr, character(1))))]

# make room above the brackets in each panel
blank <- rbind(rng[, .(Measure, y = lo - span * 0.03)], kw[, .(Measure, y = y + span * 0.06)])

n_per <- table(meta$Cluster)
xlab_fn <- function(x) paste0(x, "\n(n = ", n_per[x], ")")

mut_p <- stats_dt[Test == "Wilcoxon" & Group == "AR-mutated vs wild-type"]
cap <- paste0(
  "Boxes: median and interquartile range; whiskers: 1.5 x IQR. Pairwise two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum tests, ",
  "Benjamini-Hochberg adjusted. Triangles: AR-mutated tumors; open circles: no IMPACT data. ",
  "AR-mutated vs wild-type (n = ", mut_p$n[1], "): score P = ", sprintf("%.2f", mut_p[Variable == "AR signaling score"]$p),
  ", AR expression P = ", sprintf("%.3f", mut_p[Variable == "AR expression (VST)"]$p), " (Wilcoxon, unadjusted)."
)
cap <- paste(strwrap(cap, 118), collapse = "\n")

p <- ggplot(long, aes(Cluster, Value)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Cluster), alpha = 0.35, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.55,
               colour = "grey25", linewidth = 0.35) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = AR_status, shape = AR_status), size = 1.9,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, seed = 42)) +
  geom_segment(data = pw, aes(x = g1, xend = g2, y = y, yend = y), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_segment(data = pw, aes(x = g1, xend = g1, y = y, yend = y - tick), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_segment(data = pw, aes(x = g2, xend = g2, y = y, yend = y - tick), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(data = pw, aes(x = (g1 + g2) / 2, y = y, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            parse = TRUE, vjust = -0.35, size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(data = kw, aes(x = 0.45, y = y, label = label), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            parse = TRUE, hjust = 0, size = 2.5) +
  geom_blank(data = blank, aes(y = y), inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = xlab_fn) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cluster_cols, guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Mutated" = "#D62728", "Wild-type" = "#52606D", "No IMPACT" = "#9AA5B1"), name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Mutated" = 17, "Wild-type" = 16, "No IMPACT" = 1), name = NULL) +
  facet_wrap(~Measure, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(x = "RNA-seq cluster (k = 3)", y = NULL, caption = cap) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 8, base_family = "Helvetica") +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 8),
        axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.35), axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.35),
        legend.position = "bottom", legend.key.size = unit(3, "mm"),
        plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 6, colour = "grey30"),
        plot.margin = margin(4, 6, 4, 4))

# Nature double-column width: 183 mm = 7.2 in
save_plot(file.path(out_dir, "AR_signaling_boxplots"), width = 7.2, height = 3.9,
          draw_fn = function() print(p))
```

# How to read the results

- **Is cluster 3 high in AR signaling?** Compare the median score per cluster and the Kruskal-Wallis and pairwise tests. A clearly higher score in cluster 3 supports the label; if it is not higher, the label needs another source.
- **Do AR mutations change the score?** See "AR-mutated vs wild-type" and the model adjusted for cluster. With 6 AR-mutated tumors, a non-significant result does not rule out an effect.
- **Most AR variants are in-frame repeat indels** (polyQ/polyG), which may be repeat-length variation rather than functional mutations. The heatmap shows the variant type for this reason.
